verdict.rationale: Working Copy is a native iOS/iPadOS Git client installed on the user's own device, so self-hosting the core product does not apply to this kind of product. Its support for private GitHub Enterprise, GitLab and Gitea instances, Linux/NAS hosts, and its built-in WebDAV server concerns connecting to self-hosted Git servers. Those are adjacent features, not self-hosting of Working Copy itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
